description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance Curfew Order under Section 16. Curfew Commence from 07.00 hour of May 11th 2022 to 07.00 hour of 12th May 2022
categorisation: This gazette content is a Curfew Order issued under Section 16 of the Public Security Ordinance. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework by imposing restrictions on public movement in specified areas during a designated time period. The content involves the exercise of statutory powers to create binding legal requirements for citizens, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
